verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents IMAP/SMTP access to its inboxes. Any standard client such as Thunderbird can connect over this open protocol and retrieve mail, which offers a route to take message data elsewhere. The docs never describe an actual export or offboarding feature, nor how to get all account data out. missing for 10: a documented bulk export of all data (inboxes, threads, labels, lists, drafts, attachments, metadata), stated open export formats such as mbox/EML/JSON, offboarding or account-deletion guidance, and independent confirmation that a full export works in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Connect Outlook, Thunderbird, Apple Mail, or any IMAP/SMTP-compatible client to your AgentMail inbox
